name: Farmhouse Style Furniture - Custom Furniture & Kitchen Cabinets | White Bear Lake
old_description: At our core, we have a simple mission: to create handcrafted furniture that is both desirable and affordable. We understand the frustration of searching endlessly for the perfect piece, only to find it either out of reach financially or needing more quality. That’s why we have made it our goal to redefine the concept of “affordable furniture” by offering timeless, unique, and durable pieces made from solid wood. Our commitment extends beyond simply providing furniture. We deeply care about our community and have identified a genuine need for high-quality furniture at an accessible price point. By doing so, we aim to bring the beauty and craftsmanship of our pieces to a broader audience within our community and beyond.
about:
Farmhouse Style Furniture operates from White Bear Township, Minnesota. The business traces its start to 2012 when founder James Putnam built a dining table for a friend, sparking demand for his custom woodworking. By 2017 Putnam left his previous job to pursue the craft full time, and the company now runs as a family-owned shop with James Putnam, Nathan Glenz, and Trevor Putnam leading the team.

The shop produces custom furniture and cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, mudrooms, and living rooms. Every piece is handcrafted from solid wood — oak, cherry, maple, or walnut — using traditional joinery such as dovetail, mortise-and-tenon, and tongue-and-groove joints. The workflow follows a four-step collaboration: design consultation, detailed planning, precision handcrafting, and final installation. A showroom on site lets clients review materials and finishes before production begins.

The customer base is residential homeowners seeking made-to-fit pieces. Recent projects cited in reviews include a sewing cabinet, a bathroom vanity, a mudroom hall tree, a pandemic-era homeschooling table and benches that became a permanent dining set, dining chairs delivered ahead of schedule, a hall-tree entry piece, a dining table with bar stools, and bedroom suites with beds, dressers, and hallway storage.

The company states its mission is to redefine affordable furniture by offering timeless, one-of-a-kind pieces built to last. Putnam emphasizes that the business exists to meet a community need for high-quality, accessible craftsmanship, turning each client's vision into a durable, personalized product.
